html:
Question 11
?

Find the general solution of the exact differential equation

(3y2−6x2y)dx+(6xy−2x3−sin⁡y)dy=0

with the initial condition y(1)=0.

a
 2x3y2−3x2y2=−y
b
 2x3y2−3x2y2=0
c
 3x2y2−2x3y−cos⁡y=−1
d
 3xy2−2x3y−2cos⁡y=−2
e
 3xy2−2x3y+cos⁡y=1
Submit
